name: E-L Financial Corporation Limited
summary: E-L Financial Corporation Limited operates as an investment and insurance holding company in Canada. It operates in two segments, E-L Corporate and Empire Life. The company owns investments in equities and fixed income securities directly and indirectly through common shares, investment funds, closed-end investment companies, limited partnerships, and other private and investment companies.
